luffy.role: Premium captain with stretched contact reach, Haki specializations and selectable Gear attack profiles.
luffy.strength: Long contact reach and a choice of area pressure, focused attacks and eligible-target control; purchased Observation adds concealed-target access.
luffy.weakness: Higher placement and upgrade prices, shared stamina and forced Gear exits. Obstacles remain blockers, and resistant targets reject control. Each active form offers only its highest unlocked contextual Technique.

zoro.role: Cutting damage specialist with close sweeps, a flying-slash stance and King of Hell.
zoro.strength: Strong measured armored-target and concealed-target damage when the appropriate Haki purchases are funded.
zoro.weakness: No healing or crowd-control substitute. Stance selection, projectile misses and the draining King of Hell profile constrain output; obstacles remain relevant.

nami.role: Weather artillery using Clima-Tact lightning, Zeus-assisted target handling and a separate Heat Egg schedule.
nami.strength: Area lightning and preparation-cadence upgrades; Gust Sword provides sourced displacement before Raitei replaces it.
nami.weakness: No purchased electrical slow or stun, concealed-target detection, regeneration denial or immunity bypass. Heat Egg is a static optional attack and does not receive Manga purchase modifiers. Raitei replaces the displacement Technique at tier five.

usopp.role: Ranged plant-ammunition specialist with Kuro Kabuto growth, sleeping gas and a Humandrake trap schedule.
usopp.strength: Range purchases measurably extend firing opportunities; sleep supplies ordinary-target control, and the Observation adaptation enables concealed acquisition.
usopp.weakness: Aimed projectiles can miss moving targets. Nemuri stays harmless in every active build and is replaced by Impact Wolf from tier four. The optional trap schedule stays static across purchases; detection does not reveal enemies to allies or bypass obstacles.

sanji.role: Close kick fighter with Diable and Ifrit profiles, burn damage and optional meal healing.
sanji.strength: Combines combat with secondary living-ally recovery. The measured cooking-price revision makes that support affordable while keeping Chopper more efficient as a dedicated medic.
sanji.weakness: Short contact envelope, supplied-injury and healing-radius requirements, fixed burn ticks and stamina limits. Cooking purchases do not directly increase damage. No Raid Suit, defensive exoskeleton or free movement is implemented.

chopper.role: Low-cost field doctor with free ordinary Point choices and bounded Monster Point combat.
chopper.strength: All five Doctor purchases improve actual healing to injured living allies, including without enemies and during other forms.
chopper.weakness: Very low measured damage. Healing cannot reach distant or obstructed allies and cannot resurrect. No hostile Chopperphage, disease-specific cure action or Guard Point defensive combat is invented. Cheap duplicate placements and shared healing demand remain outside the tested single-placement protocol.

robin.role: Visible-crowd grappler using simultaneous blossoms, Gigante Fleur and Demonio Fleur.
robin.strength: Strong measured area damage and control against eligible targets. Shared resource and contextual profiles give distinct grappling and larger-form choices.
robin.weakness: No concealed-target detection or implemented Haki. Resistant targets reject the relevant control. The host must mark legacy stun immunity with stunnable=false or weakWilled=false; a boss tag alone is insufficient. Sea Serpent damage is disclosed physical grasping force, not a later-arc move.

franky.role: Heavy cyborg artillery with BF-37 weapons and a distinct General Franky profile.
franky.strength: High measured visible-wave damage from ranged weapons and named beam/cannon attacks.
franky.weakness: No concealed-target detection or fabricated rapid-aim correction. Fuel costs, profile drains and projectile geometry limit attacks. Automatic fuel recovery is a disclosed bounded bookkeeping adaptation, not canonical self-refueling or unlimited cola.

brook.role: Soul Solid fencer and musician combining chill with harmless sleeping music.
brook.strength: Measured control against hearing-enabled concealed targets after detection purchases; every unlocked Nemuriuta cast remains non-damaging.
brook.weakness: Modest direct damage. Dedicated musical sleep requires hearing eligibility, while generic contact stuns and pulses use separate weakWilled/stunnable gates. A host must configure both systems to model a fully control-immune enemy. No repeat resurrection or damaging ghost spell is implemented.

jinbe.role: Fish-Man Karate fighter with armor pressure, distinct grip and throw Techniques, and shockwave collateral.
jinbe.strength: Defense-transmitting force, Armament and Observation purchases provide armored and concealed-target options; eligible-target displacement has explicit entrance clamps.
jinbe.weakness: Contact reach and projectile misses constrain output. Buraikan replaces Karakusagawara's area wave with a focused attack. No self-generated water, water terrain, defensive block simulation or helmsman range buff. Shared armor pressure is an explicit Karate adaptation across contacts.
